name: Kamijou Tsubasa
source:
The captain of the school's volleyball club with exceptional physical ability and leadership who is adored by her teammates.
She has stoic personality and determined spirit hating to lose.
She tries to conceal the woman-side of herself, but in fact she is a possessor of beautiful face and feminine body.
